notes.title: Falnarion Tactics II Surprise Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35003694/6c83759af7941551673cb4e882ecd7362be5f387.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to the surprise update for Falnarion Tactics II! This wasn't supposed to happen, but here it is!

Here is what is new:

-New Weapons: Kitchen Knife, Frying Pan, Giant Log, Ripping Shadow, Oracle Blade X and Torch. They have been added into the weapon shops.

-Memory Fragments have increased by 3 in the Item Shop.

-Added two more Utility Hammers in the Item Shop.

-Fixed the Shadowblade side quest that remained even if you
completed it.

-Fixed Tolem and Ether's motion avoiding weapon animation.

-Nerfed the final boss as they are completely OP and near impossible to beat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35003694/791681d04cd755d817972020095414693f773eac.jpg[/img]
-Added in two new characters; Temi Elkenu, from Exiori and
a brand new female character; Listeria Olfenberry, The Bard.

-Added in a new side quest called: Incubus Lair.
You can recruit the new characters in this quest.

It's not much, but, it's something. Thanks for playing Falnarion Tactics II (If you did). I hope that one day,
someone does a full play-through of it on Youtube, I think that would be cool! But, either way thanks for your interest!

Exiori coming soon, check it out here:

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics II v1.5 update! (Major Hotfix Mostly). (No more updates).
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35003694/30d6f1933bbf66bb4daec4e102ecf0aaa37c5711.png[/img]
Falnarion Tactics II v1.5 update.
(Basically a big hot-fix).

While I was without internet, I decided to play Falnarion Tactics II and I found some issues that I wanted to address and address them I shall. While I was here fixing bugs that I caught with my eyes, I thought I'd add in something new since I won't be updating again. (And wasn't legitimately planning on it either). But I'm not one to let things go.

If there is a visible problem I can fix, then fix it I will and add more content while doing it probably.

Since this is a mainly a hot fix, let me share what is fixed:

-Clestera and Habber's pictures are corrected in the side quest; Most For One.

-In the side quest; Stronghold 2, the incorrect battle prep screen song played. That is fixed.

-Milo's level up stats were more attuned to a sword wielding warrior instead of a magic user. So I corrected it.
(It may not reflect in your current play-through).

-Arestol's Enchanter class change now contains an upgrade of movement speed.

(It's very important to note that in the first Falnarion Tactics, class changes weren't about stat changes, but the ability to learn new and different skills and use different weapons and to be able to level up again while maintaining most of your old stats).

-Lowered Oracle Burst's Durability from 14 to 3 as it was a way too powerful weapon with far too much reach to be used too many times.

-Lowered Oracle Burst's price from 25,000 to 20,000.

-Changed some enemy bosses' weapons from broadswords to something stronger as they were meant to have.

-Fixed the Iron Fist icon.

-Changed the music in the side quest; The Test, to reflect the music in Tales of Beasteria while unlocking the cameo characters.

-Changed Skaul's face image to reflect his appearance in Tales of Beasteria.

-Buffed the Nightmare Blade's stats.

-Recolored Elicor's battle sprite.

-Fixed some grammar.

-Buffed the Void Slayer spear and increased the range from 1-2 to 1-5.

-Anyone with the skill; "Left Over Move" will now be able to move after most actions like Attacking, using items or shops and not just limited actions like in the first game.

-Changed Elicor's hair from green to pink to match his battle sprite better.

Lore explanation: He dyed his hair brown in honor of Momo, but messed up and now it's Pink. Many jokes were made, but ultimately people don't talk about it anymore.

-Some skills icons may have changed.

-Fixed a switch where Maiya's chat was hidden after unlocking her. *Changes may not reflect on current play-through*.

-Changed the weapon attack sound effect for some people.

-Fixed some cut off points for dialogue on some side quests.

-Fixed some missing party member descriptions for some side quests and some icons.

-The weapons; Crusher and Club have changed from Axe to Hammer type.

-Changed the animation and icon for the spell-book/tome; Seinaru.

-Changed the music in the side quest; Succubus Lair, as an easter egg for Deterioration.
(Deterioration battle theme).

New Things:

-New weapon for Astren; Striker. (A bow-sword).

-A new weapon type; Hammers.

-A new weapon shop; Hammer shop.

-A new weapon; Iron Hammer.

-A new weapon; Golden Mallet.

-A new side quest; Hired Help II. (Featuring the battle theme from L'Cestrue Seyuntres).

-A new character; Traveling Merchant Group. Includes Teyina, Yuzo and Kona as one combined unit.

*Teyina's face/sprite featured on the outside, others shown in battle.* (Unlock Teyina in Hired Help II).

That is all for this game. I hope those who played it enjoy it and if you have yet to, will enjoy it as well!



If you have already beaten Falnarion Tactics II, you are able to finish the new side quest. But, even if you haven't you are still able to. On another note, If you want a continuation of the story of FT II in a non-cannonical way and made by a different person, play Tales of Beasteria.

Please check out Tales of Beasteria:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203030/Tales_of_Beasteria/

Also feel free to check out L'Cestrue Seyuntres coming soon:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1218110/LCestrue_Seyuntres/

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics II v1.4 update! (All updates and news are concluded).
notes.content:
Hello. Today I'd like to share with you the new update for Falnarion Tactics II. This update is the last update for Falnarion Tactics II. There will be a silent maintenance update in the future to fix a couple of things that may or may not be found. But this is it for new content as far as free things go. So without wasting any more time lets see what is new:


-Added in the Archeon Blade. (Strongest sword in the game).

-Added in the Angeko's Call. (A versatile and powerful sword).

-Fixed some missing dialogue.

-Added in a few new quality of life things.

-Added in Scel. (A dark knight).

-Added in Timo. (A priest).

-Added in Lysthenia (A maid assassin).

-Added in Skaul. (A soulless skeleton knight). (Halloween Special Add-On).

-Added in Cassandra (A monk with fist weapons).

-Seraphic Feathers durability has increased from 2 to 3.

-Last, but not least. I know I said before it couldn't be done atm, but it has been and Ether Maxwell is added into the game and has made the cut!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35003694/b70087591781ff593c45f783ebbd53ce3a180d8c.jpg[/img]

*In order to get all six characters, you need to purchase the horn of heroes from the item shop, use it during battle to unlock the new side quest: The Test. Once you complete that, you unlock all 6 new allies at once.*

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics II v1.2 update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35003694/477c156211976dd856891ad8cc83d0ee37ccf08e.gif[/img]

Welcome to the next update for Falnarion Tactics II.

In this update there are some new things added so take a look:


-New Item: Gaia Feather (Revives Allies aka Green Units).

-New Item: Demonic Feather (Revives Enemies aka Red Units).

-Changed the U.I. for the game's menus outside of combat.

-Changed the message box's appearance.

-Added in a new difficulty for the start of a new game; Hell.
(Double Exp, Pursuit is on, No Counter Attacks, Randomized number of
units allowed per mission).

-Increased the difficulty of chapter 12 exponentially.

-Because people reported that the start of the game was a bit too hard for some people, I went ahead and activated the shops for chapters 1 and 2. You can also spend bonus points on double exp. You still won't be able to access the Base until you beat chapter 2, but at least now you'll be able to shop and have a better advantage! 

The shops will only be available during those
chapters and will only be available during base afterwards.

-You can now recruit Arnette in chapter 11 by talking to her with Tolem.
She will join in chapter 12 if the conditions are met.

Arnette has different forms she can switch to by using up a turn.
Aside from her default Sword Form which allows her to use Swords
and Scythes.

She can also change into a Lance Form (Lances and Battle Staves), an Axe Form (Axes) and a Beast Form (Claws). Her appearance changes whenever she changes forms and her Beast Form is a Harpy which allows her to fly.

Each form has different stat distributions and skills. You can remain in the form during the duration of a fight for as long as you wish.

-Fixed the animation of a chest in the side quest; Most For One.

*Due to the fact that I'll be gone for awhile. I won't be able to fix certain things and update the game for possibly a long time. I hope that everything ends up being fine, but I am sure it is as it's all been tested. Please enjoy this update!

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics II will tie up Restoration's Story.
notes.content:
At the end of Restoration (The good ending). It was unclear at what happened in the end and what would happen after. Thanks to Restoration being canonically included in this game, you will find out what happened after Oliver and Penello's journey. There is also a Solenars Edge Series secret within the game's main story. For those hardcore fans, something very important is revealed in this game. I also want to say that as of now, Chapter 10 is finished.
As planned, once Chapter 11 is finished. All three new chapters will be released in v0.9. Please stay tuned!

notes.title: Current Status.
notes.content: Please don't worry, the game is still being worked on and I want to tell you that chapter 9 is finished and chapters 10 and 11 are still being worked on. v0.9 should come out in two weeks or so. notes.title: Falnarion Tactics II v0.8 update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35003694/1942498c9f30b27439da729645208873e0a8d15e.jpg[/img]

So some things have changed. As I was working on the story, I noticed that it may be a bit rushed with the amount of chapters I had. So I added in one more and increased the max from 11 to 12. Because of this, I had to hold off on my plan of adding in chapters 7,8 and 9 in v0.8.

Chapter 7 was released in the last update and Chapter 8 is released in this update. Chapter 9 will be released in v0.9 instead alongside chapters 10 and 11.

There is more content now and the story continues yet again, however for those pesky three chapters in a row for whatever numbers they may be (Hopefully chapters 9,10 and 11). That will take some time. So expect early to mid July. Regardless, there is only 4 more chapters until release and 2 more main updates. The game is almost finished.

Thank you for your continued support.

-Chapter 8 is now available!

-Fixed various issues.

Lastly, you may be wondering why this update came out so fast and why I couldn't just add in 9 and 10 at a later date.

The answer: If someone were to finish chapter 7 and then save, they would accidentally end up being stuck in a loop as they were transported to an unfinished chapter 9 and skipping over 8. So that issue was fixed in this update asap and  chapter 8 was added in.

notes.title: Important Choice.
notes.content: So, with the deadline nearing and Tolem's sprite not made. I am going to have a place holder in combat for the time being instead of delaying the game for a second time. With this in mind, the game is almost ready and available, but as it is a game in progress, knowing this detail please take that character with a grain of salt. If you are an pixel artist who can make the character in under 2 weeks please message me and we can work something out. Otherwise he will remain half-finished for some of the EA. notes.title: FT II is approved for EA Release!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35003694/bb091971c60b5eb35adcda3a9c1ad97ef405db8b.png[/img]
Unfortunately, I won't release it today and will stick to the release date. All the maps are completed, pretty much all the side quests are too and are undergoing testing. I want to release the EA with at-least 3 story chapters finished which are still a work in progress and the main thing holding it back is the lack of Tolem's sprite and because of this, the game *may* get delayed in the future, but most likely not. On another note, I won't allow the player to go into the base until after chapter 1 is finished so that the player 100 percent knows that there is a story in front of their face.

notes.title: Looking for one Beta Tester!
notes.content:
1. Must be readily available!

2. Must be good at SRPG games and know how to use strategy.

3. You get to play the game before early access, so must know how to keep spoilers under wraps.

4. Must be willing to accomplish certain tasks with directions etc.

5. Compensation is Restoration, Solenars Edge Heroes, Falnarion Tactics, Deatherem, Estellium Legends and Falnarion Tactics II for free!

6. Must own a windows pc.

7. Must have discord and the ability to share screens/voice chat.

8. Must give criticism and point out things that are able to be changed and would look better changed and be very thorough.

Please email me at Syukino56@gmail.com for more details!

notes.title: Survival Mode!
notes.content:
Alongside the main campaign of Falnarion Tactics II. There will be included a brand new Survival Mode. What Survival mode essentially is, is a mode where you unlock all the main characters off the bat and have to survive through all of the side quests. With perma-death enabled. This mode is not for the faint of heart and is mainly only for the veterans of the SRPG genre!

Survival Mode will be fully completed upon launch into early access. Please look forward to it as it is coming soon!

notes.title: Small delay.
notes.content: I will be delaying the early access launch of Falnarion Tactics II due to unforeseen irl issues. But, please keep in mind that when it releases it will be closed to being finished a lot more then the first Falnarion Tactics. Thank you for understanding and I hope to see you when the game comes out in early access in June and gets fully released near the end of this year.
